<!-- pr-reviewer: 600355aaa2815019b2b66720ecadd58db99c0db2 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The local trial merge with upstream main `da3c36389e36a1d4d5cb9ef45ea8bb03df9ec61a` is clean.

Checks:
- The executor completes the shared heavy queue and the isolated heavy targets before it starts ordinary suites.
- The change keeps duration sorting within each shared queue, isolation rules, job limits, selectors, and failure reporting.
- The new tests check the plan and the executor order. Existing tests check concurrent execution, failed builds, continued execution after failures, and checkout guards.
- The decision record and `Process change: yes` line are present. The PR does not edit `PROCESS_VERSION`.

Local build and test results:
- `cargo test -p xtask --no-run`: passed.
- `cargo test -p xtask`: 178 passed, 0 failed. This includes 163 unit tests and 15 integration tests.
- `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- Release dry runs: 1,095 steps without snapshots and 1,097 with snapshots. All heavy steps precede ordinary suites.
- Current upstream adds one ordinary suite to the counts in the PR body.
- `--only "app heavy: pocket3d_hsm"` selects exactly one step.
- `git diff --check`: passed.

Requested changes: none.

This PR changes gate scheduling only. It changes no posted G-code, geometry, stock simulation, or collision checks. It moves no goldens. No UI screenshots are required.

I did not repeat the author's mutations. This is not a safety-tier change. I did not run the full release gate or its heavy CAM tests. I did not use a GitHub runner.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
